origin.meridian_humanoid.reborn.name: Reborn
origin.meridian_humanoid.reborn.talent.1: You remember a breathing practice from a later age.
origin.meridian_humanoid.reborn.talent.2: You already know how to gather qi with your breath.
advancements.meridian_humanoid_host.cult: Village Folk
Most villagers know only a few plain skills: Breathing, Light Step and Charge. Still, they are no easy mark once a fight starts.
The Thousand-Mile Leg
The trader leading llamas walks the Thousand-Mile Leg: an ordinary one knows Road, one who has refined true qi also knows Ambush, and a rare few master Journey.
Wayfarer
A pillager's crossbow follows the Wayfarer's way; one who has refined true qi also draws the Hundred Paces bow, and a rare few master Myriad Arrows.
Door Breaker
A vindicator's axe is made for doors: it splits wooden doors, wooden trapdoors and fence gates but never strikes iron; those who have refined true qi know more, and a rare few master Myriad Doors.
Potion Arts
Swamp witches know the Nourish form of the Potion Arts, and those who have refined true qi also know Lure; they have brewed all their lives and often carry recipes.
A Seized Scroll
Cultivators carry their technique scrolls with them. Only when you defeat, with your own hands, someone who knows the art may their scroll fall to you.
Technique Codex
When you first master a scroll of arts, this little book slips quietly into your coat. Should you misplace it, bind any plain book anew with thread, and the ink will bleed back onto the page.
The Whole Codex
Every art recorded within has been seen through to the end. The chronicler's scattered pages are whole once more, the realm's kicks, fists, and keen edges gathered beneath this brush.
[Preface]
The Practised resemble normal Villagers or Pillagers, but hold true skill: Wandering Qi or True Qi. True Qi ones are harder and know one more manual. All know three basics: Breath, Light Step, and Charge.

Wind-ups break to heavy hits: blunt best, blades next, arrows third; fire, ice, poison fail. They stagger: no new move, half speed. Moves under 0.5s or mere shoves cannot break. They also interrupt your slow moves.

Badly hurt, a limb near ruin, or arms spent, they Light Step or walk away, hitting back if pressed. Beyond 12 blocks, they pant, then chime: Breath, taking about 1s, breakable. Afterward limbs recover fast, but blood does not return.

Healed back past half, arms near full, 12 blocks off, they return; cornered, they fight to the end. Harm one, allies within 16 blocks grudge for half a minute. Get 32 blocks off and out of sight to shake them. Slay one who knows a whole manual and it may drop.

[Vindicator]
At 4 to 24 blocks, he stands to Charge, gasps, a faint ping, then Light Steps to 1.5 blocks away to strike. He stands still until his axe lands, then follows slowly. Afterward his arms weaken for 6 to 9 seconds—press him then!

Knock: 3 hits (<0.5s, unbreakable). Door Breaker: 1.6s chop. Door Ram rams. Shield Breaker breaks shields. Sweep: 1.7s, hits 5 max. Shut Door: 2 hops back, axe. Door Chain: 3 slashes. Ten Thousand Doors: 2.1s, leaps, cleaves 4 blocks ahead.

Slow moves over 1.5s startup are only used within 2.5 blocks of you, and never right after being hit. Door Breaker and Ten Thousand Doors break wooden doors, trapdoors, and fence gates within 2 blocks, but not iron doors.

[Wandering Trader]
Snap Kick: 1s, unbreakable. Push Kick. Mule Kick (unbreakable launch). Ground Sweep trips. True Qi traders, under half hurt and facing you alone, attack: Whip Kick, Chain Kicks, Flying Kick (8 blocks), Leave No Trace (2.8s).

Axe Kick downs shielded or leaping foes. If legs tire or kicks aren't ready, he retreats without kicking or jumping. Cornered and ready, he steps to 2 blocks and waits facing you; if not, he sidles along the wall, switching corners once you are 3 blocks off.

[Pillager]
Alert within 100 blocks, he closes in to shoot. Repeater users fire from 92 to 96 blocks away; Pearl String users from 81 to 85 blocks. As you rush in, they step back to maintain range. Their arrows reach that far.

Still past 16 blocks: Kneeling Shot, Full Moon. Moving: 5-shot Repeater or Pearl String. Inside 8 blocks: Crosswind (6 arrows) if two or more foes or in 3 blocks with crossbow; Bow Tip bash and shot if bow in 3 blocks; else shoots.

If sight is lost, he searches; those with Ten Thousand Arrows loose an Arrow Rain. If heavily hurt and pursued, he uses Parting Shot, firing while retreating. True Qi Pillagers carry an extra bow, swapping between bow and crossbow.

[Witch]
Hurt in arms and legs, none within 8 blocks, she stands to Imbibe (3 gulps, over 3s); if hurt badly in one spot, she will Anoint. Both break. Pressed or surrounded, she throws Charm; within 2 blocks, she drops it at her own feet.

True Qi Witches lob from 4 to 14 blocks: Armor Rot vs heavy armor, Withering if fleeing. In 3.5 blocks, she splashes, then mists: tainted foes in 16 blocks suffer again at half effect, through walls. A bucket of milk clears it.

[Evoker]
Practised Evokers no longer dye sheep red. True Qi ones chant past 8 blocks, hands glowing for 2s (breakable). For about 18s after, his attacks and summoned Fangs and Vex inflict extra harm of that element.
Beyond 12 blocks, he takes 2 to 3 seconds to cast Thick Earth or Returning Water, bolstering his legs and speeding recovery. When his hands glow, strike hard during those 2 seconds to interrupt him.

[Villager]
Villagers know basics but never strike. Facing foes they Light Step back and Breath afar. If enemies threaten, 3 Villagers summon an Iron Golem. Harm one, and Villagers, traders, and Iron Golems in 16 blocks grudge for half a minute.

[Afterword]
Pillagers, Vindicators, Evokers, Witches, Illusioners are one band; Villagers, traders, Iron Golems another. Your wolves or summons count as you: they hit one only if it bites them and you are out of reach. Smash wind-ups with blunt force.
crisis.meridian_humanoid.covetous.omen.r: Axe-bearing strangers arrived at the village edge, asking around for where you lodge.
Unfamiliar faces probe by the alley mouth, quietly asking if you carry cultivation scrolls.
crisis.meridian_humanoid.covetous.omen.n: Eyes are upon you, and the scrolls and potions upon your person.
Keep them well; when the time comes, someone will come to take them.
In these coming days, the moment dusk falls, we come.
crisis.meridian_humanoid.covetous.leader: We meet again. You kept your life last time; let us see what prize you carry now.
advancements.meridian_humanoid_host.cult: Whispers on the Wind
Hear a villager speak in hushed tones of strangers asking after you, or find a note left by your bed or on the ground behind you, warning that they come to take what you carry.
Uninvited Guests
The band that comes knocking is repelled only when their leader falls; the followers will scatter, and from the leader drops a rare martial scroll.
Old Foes Cross Paths
The grudge-bearing leader perishes when returning with his band, or is overtaken and cut down in retreat; whatever he took from you shall be recovered.
Settling Old Scores
Foes carried from birth have an end. Slay the leader of the last to seek you out, and this old feud is settled; henceforth, none shall come for it.
origin.meridian_humanoid.farmer.name: Humble Village Farmer
origin.meridian_humanoid.farmer.story: You are the child of humble village tillers, born of forefathers who faced the yellow earth for generations, bearing neither pedigree nor renown. The villagers have watched you grow from infancy and hold you dear, ever willing to yield a fairer price whenever you trade with them. No born feuds dog your steps, and for now your days are quiet. Yet should your cultivation attain true greatness in the years to come, envious eyes shall surely seek you out all the same.
origin.meridian_humanoid.farmer.talent.1: Every villager holds 20 more reputation toward you than toward others; higher reputation brings cheaper trade.
origin.meridian_humanoid.orphan.name: Massacred Clan's Sole Survivor
origin.meridian_humanoid.orphan.story: In years past, your enemies extinguished your entire household in a single night, leaving you as the sole survivor. Fortunately, having memorized Wayfarer: Bow I · Hundred Paces since childhood, you dwell in Wandering Qi and can loose it the moment you draw a bow. Yet those foes know the roots were not severed, and sooner or later they will come seeking you in three waves, each fiercer than the last. This reckoning is one that must be settled in due time.
origin.meridian_humanoid.orphan.talent.1: You know Wayfarer: Bow I · Hundred Paces from the start, and can wield it at Wandering Qi.
origin.meridian_humanoid.orphan.threat.1: Your foes will come before long in three waves in all, each stronger than the last; repelling the third settles the score.
origin.meridian_humanoid.apprentice.name: Apothecary Apprentice
origin.meridian_humanoid.apprentice.stor: From childhood, you followed a master in an apothecary to learn the craft of decoctions; abiding in Wandering Qi, you could long wield Brewing. You keep Qi Gathering Soup and Bitter Yellow Paste, left behind by the master, engraved in memory without missing a single word. Yet the recipes were seized by a witch who attained True Qi, and the master is gone. Knowing you still hold the formulas within, she will come seeking you before long.
origin.meridian_humanoid.apprentice.tale: You know Brewing from the start, and can perform it at Wandering Qi.
You know how to brew Qi Gathering Soup and Bitter Yellow Paste from the start, which help draw in more qi during breathing and slowly heal wounds on the limbs.
origin.meridian_humanoid.apprentice.thre: A witch who has reached True Qi will come to your door before long; defeating her settles the matter, but if she escapes, she will return even stronger.
origin.meridian_humanoid.disgraced.name: Fallen Minister's Scion
origin.meridian_humanoid.disgraced.story: Your forebears once served the imperial court, but ruin followed upon their fall from grace. Fortunately, your house preserved Door Breaker: Upper Volume · Wooden Doors, and dwelling already in the realm of Wandering Qi, you can unleash it at will. Yet the old charges were never cleared; axe-bearing Vindicators form bands at long intervals to hunt you down, and even when driven back they will return, leaving no end to this trouble in your lifetime.
origin.meridian_humanoid.disgraced.talen: Door Breaker: Upper Volume · Wooden Doors left by your family is known from the start, wieldable at Wandering Qi.
origin.meridian_humanoid.disgraced.threa: The first squad arrives before long; Vindicators form squads to hunt you only at long intervals with no end in your lifetime, and their leader carries Door Breaker: Lower Volume · Myriad Doors.
origin.meridian_humanoid.merchant.name: Scion of Peddlers
origin.meridian_humanoid.merchant.story: For generations, your forebears shouldered carrying poles and peddled their wares, wandering through streets and alleys to ply their trade. Accustomed to bearing heavy packs since childhood, you travel with far less effort under the same burdensome load, and your strides carry you much further than others. Yet Pillagers and Vindicators have long set their covetous eyes upon your goods, descending to plunder you every once in a while. Though these raiders pose no grave danger, this trouble knows no end.
origin.meridian_humanoid.merchant.talent: One's reference carry weight is 1.25 times that of others; walking with the same burden demands less toil.
origin.meridian_humanoid.merchant.threat: Highwaymen shall come for the first time before long, returning at intervals thereafter; those who come are not strong, yet there is no end to it.
Strangers bearing crossbows came to the village, asking everywhere for the survivor of that family from years ago.
Men who refuse to give their names have been secretly asking where you now make your dwelling.
Surviving seed of that house, we have recognized you.
The roots were not pulled clean; we come for you now.
Within these few days, we come as dusk first falls.
crisis.meridian_humanoid.clan_foes.leade: The seed of that house dies hard indeed. You cheated death last time, but think not to slip away today.
crisis.meridian_humanoid.recipe_thief.om: An outsider woman at the village entrance asks everyone she meets about you, the apothecary's apprentice.
Someone came upon her by the well, where with a cold face she asked around which house you live in.
My eyes are on you; I know you well, apothecary apprentice.
Have the recipe and the medicine ready; wait for me to claim them.
Within these few days, I shall come the moment dusk falls.
crisis.meridian_humanoid.recipe_thief.le: Found you after all. The recipe not yielded last time, surrender it tonight.
crisis.meridian_humanoid.captors.omen.ru: A band of axe-bearing Vindicators has come to the village, asking after you of everyone they meet.
Those strangers bear cold faces, quietly prying into the old affairs of your family.
crisis.meridian_humanoid.captors.omen.no: The old case remains unsettled; we know you as the disgraced minister's kin.
Axes in hand, we shall surely come to your door to take you in.
Within these few days, we shall come the moment dusk falls.
crisis.meridian_humanoid.captors.leader_: I remember you. So long as the old case remains unclosed, the axes in our hands shall not rest.
crisis.meridian_humanoid.highwaymen.omen: Strange faces have entered the village, asking people what goods you carry in your basket.
Outsiders linger by the village entrance, pressing to know which road you will take this time.
I know who you are; I have long had my eye on you.
Leave the goods behind obediently; I am coming to take them.
Within these few days, I shall come the moment dusk falls.
crisis.meridian_humanoid.highwaymen.lead: Met again? You were fortunate to keep your life last time, but this time, all the goods upon your back stay behind.
